# Image Sources

This directory contains static images used in the blog post.

## hero.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (Imagen 3)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Usage**: Hero image for blog post listing and opening
- **Prompt**: a laptop on a wooden desk showing a split-pane text
  editor and terminal in silhouette, a notebook with handwritten
  annotations open beside it, warm desk-lamp light from the upper
  right, shallow depth of field on the notebook with the laptop screen
  softly blurred, muted palette of warm wood and cool screen blue with
  one amber accent from the lamp. Metaphor: the blueprint from the
  companion post, now open on a real workbench.
- **Date**: 2026-08-18

## ambiance1.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (Imagen 3)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Prompt**: a small breadboard-style array of labelled cable ties and
  connectors laid out in a grid on a workbench, overhead studio
  lighting, deep depth of field keeping the whole grid sharp, muted
  palette of slate grey and muted teal with one small red accent.
  Metaphor: an inventory laid out before the work begins.
- **Date**: 2026-08-18

## ambiance2.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (Imagen 3)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Prompt**: a pair of tweezers hovering over an open mechanical
  device with visible internal gears, a small desk lamp casting a
  tight pool of light from directly above, shallow depth of field on
  the gears with the surrounding bench falling into soft shadow, muted
  palette of brushed steel and warm amber light. Metaphor: stepping
  through a mechanism one part at a time.
- **Date**: 2026-08-18

## ambiance3.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (Imagen 3)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Prompt**: a finished wooden box with a working brass latch, sitting
  closed on a workbench beside the tools used to build it, soft
  natural light from a window out of frame, medium depth of field
  keeping both the box and the nearest tool in focus, muted palette of
  warm wood and dark brass. Metaphor: a package ready to ship because
  it has been proven to work.
- **Date**: 2026-08-18

## Adding Images to This Post

1. Save image to this directory: `media/images/your-image.jpg`
2. Add entry to this README.md with source, prompt, and date
3. Reference in blog post: `![  ](media/images/your-image.jpg){.img-fluid}`
